annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because its promotional narration promises that mining WankCoin will make a broke viewer wealthy, physically strong, and able to obtain a car and romantic attention, then directs him to mine it by watching pornography. The ending displays the OneCoin logo, tying those exaggerated benefit claims to the promoted coin rather than presenting them as a warning or investigation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S05 fits because the video promotes mining a named coin as a route to major personal benefits and wealth. The computer-mining instruction is the participation pathway; the claimed outcomes are not framed as a third party's quoted offer or criticized claim.
